description.narrative: Zephyr Power (PVT) Limited is a company incorporated in Pakistan which is constructing a 50 megawatt (MW) wind farm in Gharo, near Karachi.

mailing-address.narrative: BII plc, 123 Victoria Street, London, SW1E 6DE, United Kingdom

sector.narrative: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

description.narrative: In 2017, CDC committed up to $41 million ($19.8 million of equity and $20.65 million of debt) for the construction of the project. CDC is the largest shareholder in Zephyr, with the remainder held by a consortium of local partners, comprising the original developers, the Khaleeli Family, and the Gul Ahmed Metro Group.The investment is CDCís first equity investment in Pakistanís power sector in almost two decades, and first joint debt/equity investment overall.In addition to equity, we are providing project finance debt alongside Dutch DFI FMO, and United Bank Limited, one of the largest commercial banks in Pakistan.See also https://www.bii.co.uk/en/story/zephyr-power-2/
